notes.title: DumbBots is live!
notes.content:
DumbBots is [i]finally[/i] live and available to play in full (albeit later than I had originally hoped). 

If you're interested in learning some basic programming concepts, or teaching your child to learn about programming, and doing it in an entertaining way - give DumbBots a buy and try. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36660444/b4070e91fd7728c60e432d9dc63f383e7f8ffa13.gif[/img]

DumbBots also supports making custom scenarios. So if you're a teacher who wants to challenge your class, or someone who wants to make coding challenges for your friends - this game let's you do that. 



On a side note, DumbBots is a remake of DumbBots.NET which I wrote in 2012. 
And DumbBots.NET was itself a remake of my BTech university project in 2007 (called Sharp Script Bots at the time). So DumbBots is a game 14 years in the making. 

Hopefully, it helps inspire someone to pick up coding as a career or hobby.
